title: Claims with exact source spans for every included pull request
acceptance: The claims stage is shown one pull request through a pure context contract read from its fact card (title, labels, areas, flags set, the whole body, commit subjects, closed issues, quoted with < escaped, stable system text first); a test pins its fields and the byte size of one recorded pull request's request.

Each claim is admitted by code: its quote occurs word for word in the field it names (line endings read as LF), code computes the span from the first occurrence, every number in its text is in the quote by the number rule's reader, kind and status are on the menu, at most 12 a pull request, text at most 300 characters; a refused claim is dropped and listed, and the claim id is cl_ and 12 hex of sha256(repo#pr@mergeSha:field:index:start-end).

A body section that names something not verified, not done, pending or awaiting a person is found by code; when no admitted pending or flagged claim's span overlaps it, the pull request is asked once more, and a gap still left is kept, recorded and logged, never filled by code; the detector finds a section past the 4,000-character cut in each of the 12 hidden-caveat pull requests of study 03.

Claims are cached as cache/claims/<mergeSha>.json under a contract hash (claims system text, model, CLAIMS_CONTEXT_VERSION, FACTS_VERSION), read through the route cache's containment and re-admitted strictly against the pull request's text; --claims runs the stage for included pull requests only, four at a time, and without it the run makes exactly the calls it made before.

scripts/changes/replay.mjs runs collect, facts, route and claims over the seven published periods with a local cache and reports calls by role, bytes, cache hits and the caveat check of the 12; a second replay with the same cache makes zero model calls; .github/workflows/changes-replay.yml runs it twice by hand only and fails when the second pass makes a call.

Exit test (Phase 1, run by the coordinator): on the replay set every included pull request has claims with exact spans, a second replay makes zero model calls, and each of the 12 hidden-caveat pull requests has a pending or flagged claim quoting its section.

evidence.note: Branch changes/claims-stage, commit ab723995, local (Windows, not pushed): npx vitest run scripts/changes/ src/core/changes/: 19 files, 358 passed, 1 skipped (the symbolic-link case Windows cannot create); node --test scripts/changes/digest.test.mjs: 5 passed; node scripts/ci-hygiene.mjs clean; npx vitest list --config vitest.fast.config.js: 162 files (FAST_TEST_FILES 162). Red first: claims-context.js, claims.js and replay.mjs missing; 2 run-digest --claims tests failed before run-digest and digest.mjs had the flag; 2 digest.test.mjs tests failed on the new claims option until updated. Red again on purpose, one mutation each, restored after: a field added to the claims context (2 failed); 'not in this pr' and 'human gate' dropped from the caveat phrases (2, #684 first); the number rule off (2); cached claims not compared to the filed ones (1); claims on by default (every run-digest test that counts calls failed); claims for every candidate (1); claims cache not written by replay (1); hidden caveats claimed only when included (1, after a test for it was added: the first mutation passed because the recorded week includes all four); the public-repository gate removed from replay (1); the workflow on pull_request, its second-pass check off, the model token on npm ci, contents: write (1 each).

#655's claims request, system text included: 8,329 bytes (pinned). No model call made: a scratch script ran collectMergedPulls over the seven built-in periods through gh, then factCard and buildClaimsRequest: 88 distinct candidates, 581,242 bytes if every candidate were claimed (the run claims included ones only), 20 with a caveat section; each of the 12 hidden-caveat pull requests has one past character 4,000 (#655 'Not verified' from code point 4,907, its heading at 4,891). The replay and the Phase 1 exit test are not yet run: no dispatch made, by the coordinator later.

Claims stage, caveat rule, claims cache, --claims and replay built on branch changes/claims-stage, tests recorded

summary: One model call per included pull request lists its claims, each admitted by code against an exact source span, with a caveat rule for what the author says is not verified, a claims cache by merge SHA, a --claims flag and a replay command and workflow for the Phase 1 exit test.
